decisions.statement: Nothing here reads the Swift to learn the components a program compiles.
The components a program compiles are stated on its akasha ios-program page.
A Swift target names no imports between its own files.
A component list belongs to a program rather than to the app that builds the program.
Each component is alone in a directory named for its slug.
The name Xcode builds a program under is read off its ios-program page.

definition: the Swift components and build target an akasha ios-program page names
